description: CBACT04C interest calculation over untouched production fixture bytes: the foundational case that fixes what a run over real data actually does, and the one that corrects the folder brief. PINS: the 1200-GET-INTEREST-RATE '23' INVALID KEY arm at :417-419, its '00' OR '23' tolerance at :422 (so no abend), the DEFAULT retry at :436-438, the IF DIS-INT-RATE NOT = 0 true arm at :214, and the single 1300-B-WRITE-TX write at :473-500. SEEDS ARE REAL BYTES, NOT INVENTED: TCATBALF is row 0 of app/data/ASCII/tcatbal.txt verbatim - account 1, type 01, category 0001 (the genuine 17-byte TRAN-CAT-KEY) with TRAN-CAT-BAL '0000000000{', a zoned positive zero every one of that fixture's fifty rows carries; ACCTFILE is row 0 of acctdata.txt; and the XREFFILE/XREFFIL1 row is byte-identical to cardxref.txt row 48, the only row whose XREF-ACCT-ID is 00000000001. Those rows stay 36 bytes here: parity.FieldDiffer owns the pad to CVACT03Y's 50 via the declared CARDXREF_FILLER_PAD_36_TO_50 normalisation, so the fixture is never edited. XREFFILE and XREFFIL1 are deliberately the same bytes because XREFFIL1 is an alternate-index PATH over the same base KSDS (app/jcl/INTCALC.jcl:29-32), not a second dataset. CORRECTION TO THE FOLDER BRIEF, DOCUMENTED RATHER THAN ABSORBED: the brief claims acctdata's A000000000 is a group id that steers account rows into the DISCGRP A-block. It is not. Verified across all 50 rows against CVACT01Y, A000000000 sits in ACCT-ADDR-ZIP at 1-based 103-112, while ACCT-GROUP-ID at 113-122 is TEN SPACES on 50/50 rows. So MOVE ACCT-GROUP-ID TO FD-DIS-ACCT-GROUP-ID at :210 moves spaces, the READ at :416 is keyed '          ' + '01' + '0001' and misses with FILE STATUS '23', :418-419 display both disclosure-group lines, and :437 moves 'DEFAULT' into an X(10) receiver so the retry key is 'DEFAULT   ' and hits discgrp.txt row 17. DIS-INT-RATE is therefore 15.00 (bytes 17-22 '00150{'). The DEFAULT fallback is this program's fixture-faithful HAPPY PATH, not an edge case, and any case that omits those two lines while seeding unmodified acctdata is wrong. ARITHMETIC: COMPUTE WS-MONTHLY-INT = (TRAN-CAT-BAL * DIS-INT-RATE) / 1200 at :464-465 carries no ROUNDED - the keyword appears zero times in all 28 programs - so the receiver PIC S9(09)V99 truncates, which is RoundingMode.DOWN at scale 2. 0.00 at 15.00 is 0.00, and that is still WRITTEN: a zero-amount transaction is a transaction, so expectedWrites carries one 350-byte record and expectedDatasets pins the count at one. TRAN-ID is '2022071800000001' because ADD 1 TO WS-TRANID-SUFFIX at :474 runs BEFORE the STRING at :476-480, so the first generated id ends 000001 and never 000000; PARM-DATE is the 10 characters of app/jcl/INTCALC.jcl:22 PARM='2022071800' concatenated verbatim, never parsed as a date, giving an exact 10+6=16 byte fit. TRAN-CAT-CD is '0005' and not '05  ': :483 moves '05' into a PIC 9(04) numeric-display receiver. TRAN-DESC is the 24 bytes 'Int. for a/c ' + ACCT-ID followed by 76 spaces - STRING at :485-489 writes only the composed bytes and leaves the receiver tail untouched, and common.FixedWidthCodec builds the record with every PIC X span space-initialised, so the tail is spaces; the composed prefix is invariably 24 bytes and never shrinks, so that tail is invariant rather than incidental. NEGATIVE ASSERTIONS, BOTH DELIBERATE: ACCTFILE appears only in expectedFinalState, byte-identical to its seed, because 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT never runs. It is reached from :196 only on an account break with WS-FIRST-TIME NOT = 'Y', and with one input record this is the first break, so :198 merely flips the flag; and its only other call site, the ELSE at :219-220, is unreachable dead code, because the enclosing PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y' at :188 makes the IF END-OF-FILE = 'N' at :189 always true. The last account group's accumulated interest is therefore never flushed - a defect preserved verbatim, not fixed. 1400-COMPUTE-FEES, performed at :216 inside the same guard, is the '* To be implemented' stub at :518-520 and contributes no record, no field and no message. DETERMINISM: TRAN-ORIG-TS and TRAN-PROC-TS are the program's only wall-clock values, both taking the same DB2-FORMAT-TS from Z-GET-DB2-FORMAT-TIMESTAMP at :496-498. No 'now' is ever captured: a BATCH_JOB pins no clock of its own, so ParityHarness.DEFAULT_PINNED_CLOCK applies, fixed at 2022-07-19T23:12:34 after the repository-wide source footer 'Ver: CardDemo_v1.0-15-g27d6c6f-68 Date: 2022-07-19', rendering as the 26-byte '2022-07-19-23.12.34.000000'. Bytes are US-ASCII throughout, matching the app/data/ASCII fixtures, never a platform default. Each of the 14 CVTRA05Y spans is pinned by name in copybook order AND the whole 350-byte image is pinned, so a failure localises to one field while the total width still proves the trailing FILLER X(20) was emitted as spaces. PROVENANCE: every expected value here is STATICALLY DERIVED - by structured reading of the COBOL paragraphs cross-checked against the CVTRA01Y/CVTRA02Y/CVTRA05Y/CVACT01Y/CVACT03Y byte layouts, the INTCALC.jcl DD and PARM contracts (:39 RECFM=F,LRECL=350) and the real ASCII fixtures. It was never captured from, recorded against or replayed from any execution of the legacy COBOL, which is empirically impossible in this environment.
